paradigm: 3s visual WORD cue -> ~15s eyes-closed imagery -> 3s vividness
averaging_window_documented: imagery-maintenance period after hemodynamic-delay shift, per-run detrend+zscore (Horikawa & Kamitani 2017 / KamitaniLab pipeline); cue period is not the averaging target
provenance_limitation: exact averaging-window sentence + hemodynamic-shift value not re-quotable in-environment (nature.com auth-gated; PMC reCAPTCHA); determination rests on structural evidence (block-averaged single-trial amplitudes) + established Kamitani pipeline; data-descriptor design confirmed via OpenNeuro/figshare
residual_risks: 3s word-cue hemodynamic tail overlaps imagery averaging window
word cue is category-informative -> residual cue signal would be category-specific

roi_profile_control.principle: V1-dominated reliability would flag a visual word-cue artifact; HVC(LOC/FFA/PPA)-dominated reliability is consistent with object imagery
roi_profile_control.note: filled after the Phase 2 reliability screen (descriptive, post-primary)
roi_profile_control.conclusion: HVC>V1 for all 5 subjects -> the (weak) imagery reliability is higher-visual-cortex dominated, consistent with object imagery and AGAINST a V1-dominated visual word-cue artifact. Cue state CONTROLLED is corroborated by data.

state_scope: reliability-qualification question only; does NOT certify cue-vs-imagery dissociation
